# The Golden Record: Earth Material and Playback Instructions

Each Voyager spacecraft carried a gold-plated record containing selected material from Earth. The collection included 115 analog images, natural sounds, music from different cultures and eras, and spoken greetings in 55 languages.

Each record came with a cartridge and needle, along with symbolic instructions explaining the spacecraft’s origin and how to play the audio. The Golden Record thus paired a collection of material from Earth with guidance for playing it.
